Enterprise AI governance emerges as critical bottleneck as agentic agents move from pilots to fleet-scale production

#3 — Agentic AI Harness Engineering Emerges as Discipline; LLM-Based Agents Require Structured Runtime Architecture for Production — Shyam Kubeify

★ Directly addresses the architectural governance challenge Cristiano faces at Eidosmedia—how agents (LLM plus runtime harness) must be engineered with runtime controls, orchestration, and extension surfaces for enterprise deployment.

Harness engineering has emerged as a formal discipline in early 2026, defining the runtime architecture coupling LLMs to the world through tools, context management, safety controls, and orchestration surfaces. Enterprise complexity accelerates as agent fleets call APIs, spawn other agents, and reach into legacy systems never designed for autonomous decision-making. Governance frameworks must address this multi-agent complexity.
